svg.title: Progress: 72 % of the functions work through the MCP
svg.desc: One square per function. 351 of 481 Solid Edge functions in the coverage map work through the MCP, 130 fail in Solid Edge 2026 and 0 are not tested yet. By area: Application, documents and data 61 of 93; Sketches and reference planes 37 of 45; Part (ordered modeling) 60 of 74; Synchronous modeling and surfaces 36 of 50; Sheet metal 22 of 34; Assemblies 47 of 78; Drawings 64 of 81; Program configuration 24 of 26.
